paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization in Complex Terrain Based on CFD and IGA-PSO

target_contributions: AEH-prefiltered Qianjiang complex-terrain WFLOP under four wake/cost cases
improved genetic algorithm followed by continuous particle swarm refinement
non_target_baselines: Greedy, IGA-only and Greedy-PSO are paper comparison methods and are not target algorithms for this package

public_source.paper_statement: The authors do not have permission to share data.
public_source.code_status: no paper-linked author implementation or data archive located
public_source.claim_boundary: independent paper, figure and predecessor reconstruction

fixture_contract.candidate_source: hashed Fig. 9 red-point centers and neighboring AEH contour rank
fixture_contract.wind_source: hashed Fig. 5 four-bin, sixteen-direction wind rose
fixture_contract.turbine_curve_source: hashed Fig. 2 normalized power and thrust markers
fixture_contract.spatial_speed_completion: solve one multiplier per candidate so no-wake normalized power integrates to proxy AEH
fixture_contract.claim_boundary: image-derived Qianjiang proxy, not private CFD, terrain or measured data

model_contract.wake_equations: target Eqs. 16-20 with rotor-overlap averaging and RSS superposition
model_contract.wake_growth: 0.5/log(100/0.037), inheriting the direct predecessor's roughness length
model_contract.thrust_handling: retain Fig. 2 values and clamp only wake-equation Ct to [0,0.999]
model_contract.continuous_background: four-nearest inverse-distance interpolation of candidate speed multipliers

nav_completion.status: declared Table-2-scale completion because every Eq. 22 numerical input is omitted

iga.initialization: one uniform [0,1] Bernoulli assignment probability per individual
iga.selection: roulette selection using monotone feasibility-first rank weights
iga.mutation: one uniformly selected bit when an individual-level event fires; probability follows the predecessor formula from 0.1 to 0.2 by half-run
iga.survival: one global elite, completing the target statement that the optimal layout is preserved
iga.fitness_evaluation: deduplicate the current population then evaluate unique layouts in parallel

pso.inertia: target Eq. 23 increasing linearly from 0.4 to 0.9
pso.coefficient_status: declared common PSO values because target omits c1 and c2
pso.initial_state: IGA best coordinates with independently perturbed particles; retain the exact IGA point as particle zero

optimizer_contract.physical_unique_fes: actual IGA unique-layout calls plus every continuous PSO particle call

direct_predecessors.inherited_fact: representative rmin/r0=0.55 from the fitted 4-14 m/s range

missing_information: private measured one-year mast time series and observation coordinates
private CFD fields, terrain mesh and correction arrays
author source, environment, seeds, initial populations, layouts and histories
wake diffusion coefficient and DGWM rmin
PSO c1/c2, crossover cut law and mutation granularity
grid price, operating cost, capital cost, lifetime and discount rate

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: Fig. 2 shows Ct above one while target wake equations contain sqrt(1-Ct)
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: preserve digitized data but clamp only the wake-equation input to 0.999 and declare the operation

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: Table 2 and Section 4.2 report case-2 IGA-PSO as 1.3881e5 and 1.3804e5 MWh
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: preserve both facts; use neither as an exact numerical admission target

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: paper withholds the numerical CFD/resource field
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use the versioned Fig. 2/5/9 proxy and prohibit author-numerical claims

precomputation: all state/source/target rotor-averaged wake deficit ratios
hpc_contract.thread_lifecycle: one persistent worker team per optimization and one for problem precomputation
hpc_contract.allocation_policy: preallocate/swap genomes, populations, particle positions, velocities and evaluation buffers
hpc_contract.randomness: counter-keyed logical events independent of worker schedule
hpc_contract.reduction: fixed state, source and target order inside each independent evaluation
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: use all twenty Waffle CPU cores for a paper run; independent repeats may be scheduled sequentially to avoid nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the published four-case problem and predecessor-completed IGA-PSO on a versioned figure-derived proxy; not author CFD/data/source/random state or exact numerical replay
